source_contract: Store tag PackageChatView New chat onClick closes local history and calls router.push('/chat').
Screens derives conversationId only from /^\/chat\/([0-9a-f-]{36})/; /chat yields null and renders ChatNewClient.
Store tag host uses createMemoryNavigation with chrome.storage.session persistence under matrx-extend:chat-address.
Package 0.8.251 memory router push('/chat') changes address synchronously, notifies useSyncExternalStore listeners, then persists; no-op only if already at /chat.

finding: The static Store source establishes intended navigation but does not explain the live symptom. A published-product regression and root cause remain unproven without route and click-boundary evidence.
next_native_probe: Root: capture a fresh accessibility snapshot, activate the named New chat button by keyboard focus+Enter, and observe whether the transcript changes. Then open Conversations, activate its New control, and compare. diagnostic_interpretation: If named control activation does not close an open history panel, its handler likely did not run. If history closes and stored address becomes /chat while transcript persists, investigate ChatProvider/usePathname rendering. If storage stays at /chat/<id>, inspect click routing or a later navigation back to the conversation; storage write may be async, so inspect after UI settles.
